title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Engineer
description_html: Make your mark at Comcast -- a Fortune 30 global media and technology company. From the connectivity and platforms we provide, to the content and experiences we create, we reach hundreds of millions of customers, viewers, and guests worldwide. Become part of our award-winning technology team that turns big ideas into cutting-edge products, platforms, and solutions that our customers love. We create space to innovate, and we recognize, reward, and invest in your ideas, while ensuring you can proudly bring your authentic self to the workplace. Join us. You’ll do the best work of your career right here at Comcast. (In most cases, Comcast prefers to have employees on-site collaborating unless the team has been designated as virtual due to the nature of their work. If a position is listed with both office locations and virtual offerings, Comcast may be willing to consider candidates who live greater than 100 miles from the office for the remote option.)        Job Summary  Comcast is seeking an Engineer 2 - Oracle Fusion Cloud Engineer to join our Enterprise Technology team supporting Oracle Fusion Cloud applications. In this role, you will assist in the day-to-day support and operations of the Oracle Fusion Cloud platform, with a focus on Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and Cloud ERP functional areas including Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P). You will work closely with senior engineers and solution architects to deliver reliable, well-configured ERP solutions — and will have the opportunity to learn and contribute to emerging AI capabilities within Oracle Fusion over time.    Job Description    What You'll Do:       Platform Support & Integration       Assist  in the support and maintenance of Oracle Fusion Cloud platform components, including integration configurations and environment administration.        Build and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including REST/SOAP-based integrations and scheduled orchestration flows, under the guidance of senior team members.       Perform basic administration and monitoring tasks on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) in support of ERP workloads.       Help document integration designs, data flows, and configuration decisions to support platform knowledge management.           ERP Functional Support – SCM & P2P         Provide day-to-day support for Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and Procure-to-Pay modules, including issue triage and resolution.       Develop familiarity with the integration points between ERP modules (Purchasing, Inventory, Accounts Payable) and external systems.       Assist with Oracle Fusion configuration changes, testing, and deployment in coordination with functional and technical teams.       Support quarterly Oracle Fusion release reviews by  participating   in impact assessments and regression testing activities.        Work with business stakeholders and senior engineers to understand requirements and  assist   in translating them into system configurations.            Identity, Access & Security         Support Identity and Access Management (IAM) activities for Oracle Fusion platforms, including user provisioning, role assignments, and MFA configuration, following established processes and controls.       Assist  in access reviews and help ensure configurations align with audit, compliance, and security requirements.        Follow Comcast's security and data governance standards when making configuration changes across Oracle Fusion environments.           Process Standardization & Best Practices         Follow and help reinforce Oracle Fusion best practices and Comcast's process standards in day-to-day work.       Maintain  accurate   documentation for configurations, runbooks, and support procedures.        Participate in peer reviews and contribute to a culture of quality and continuous improvement.            AI Awareness & Adoption           Develop awareness of Oracle's native AI capabilities embedded in Oracle Fusion Cloud (such as AI-assisted workflows and intelligent recommendations within SCM and P2P).         Support the team in evaluating and piloting Oracle AI features as directed by senior engineers and architects.         Show curiosity and willingness to learn about AI/automation opportunities in ERP processes — formal AI development experience is not  required   at this level.           What You'll Need:      Bachelor’s degree in computer science , Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.       1–3 years of hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud applications, with exposure to SCM and/or P2P modules.       Basic working knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)  -   familiarity with integration concepts and experience supporting or building simple integrations.        Foundational understanding of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) concepts (compute, networking, IAM, storage).       Exposure to Oracle Fusion security concepts including role-based access control and basic IAM/MFA configurations.       Ability to troubleshoot Oracle Fusion configuration and integration issues with guidance from senior team members.       Understanding of  common integration concepts such as REST APIs, SOAP, and file-based data exchange.        Strong analytical mindset with good attention to detail.       Effective communication skills  -   able to clearly document issues and convey status to team members and stakeholders.             Disclaimer:  This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.       Skills  Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Oracle Fusion Applications, Process Development (PD), Python (Programming Language), Structured Query Language (SQL), Supply Chain Operations, Troubleshooting     We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That's why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality—to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life.   Please visit the  benefits summary  on our careers site for more details.     Education  Bachelor's Degree    While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.    Certifications  (if applicable)     Relevant Work Experience  2-5 Years    Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace.  We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
